help_modal.action_attack_altclick: Attack (when left click is set to open menu)
help_modal.ui_leaderboard_desc: Shows the top players of the game and their names, % owned land, gold and troops. Using Show All shows all players in the game. If you don't want to see the leaderboard, click Hide.
help_modal.ui_control_desc: The control panel contains the following elements:
help_modal.ui_pop: Pop - The amount of units you have, your max population and the rate at which you gain them.
help_modal.ui_gold: Gold - The amount of gold you have and the rate at which you gain it.
help_modal.ui_troops_workers: Troops and Workers - The amount of allocated troops and workers. Troops are used to attack or defend against attacks. Workers are used to generate gold. You can adjust the number of troops and workers using the slider.
help_modal.ui_attack_ratio: Attack ratio - The amount of troops that will be used when you attack. You can adjust the attack ratio using the slider. Having more attacking troops than defending troops will make you lose fewer troops in the attack, while having less will increase the damage dealt to your attacking troops. The effect doesn't go beyond ratios of 2:1.
help_modal.ui_events_desc: The Event panel displays the latest events, requests and Quick Chat messages. Some examples are:
help_modal.ui_events_alliance: Alliance - Alliance requests can be accepted or rejected. Allies can share resources and troops, but can't attack each other. Clicking Focus moves the view to the player who sent the request.
help_modal.ui_events_attack: Attacks - Incoming attacks and your outgoing attacks are shown. Click the message to center the view on the attack, nuke or Boat (transport ship). You can retreat troops by clicking the red X button. This will cost the lives of 25% of your attacking troops. If you retrieve a Boat attack, the boat returns to its starting point and will attack there if the land has been captured since. Nukes can't be retreated once launched.
help_modal.ui_events_quickchat: Quick Chat - You can see sent and recieved chat messages here. Send a message to a player by clicking the Quick Chat icon in their Info menu.
help_modal.ui_options_desc: The following elements can be found inside:
help_modal.ui_playeroverlay_desc: When you hover over a country, the Player info overlay is displayed under Options. It shows the type of player: Human, Nation (smart bot), or Bot. A Nation's attitude towards you, ranging from Hostile to Friendly. And defending troops, gold, plus the number of Cruisers and various buildings the player has.
help_modal.option_pause: Pause/Unpause the game - Only available in single player mode.
help_modal.option_timer: Timer - Time passed since the start of the game.
help_modal.option_settings: Settings - Open the settings menu. Inside you can toggle the Alternate view, Emojis, Dark Mode, Ninja (anonymous/random names mode), and action on left click.
help_modal.radial_desc: Right clicking (or touch on mobile) opens the Radial menu. Right click outside it to close it. From the menu you can:
help_modal.radial_boat: Send a Boat (transport ship) to attack at the selected location. Only available if you have access to water.
help_modal.info_enemy_desc: Contains information such as the selected player's name, gold, troops, stopped trading with you, nukes sent to you, and if the player is a traitor. Stopped trading means you won't receive gold from them and they won't sent you gold via cargo ships. Manually (if the player clicked "Stop trading", which lasts until you both click "Start trading") or automatically (if you betrayed your alliance, which lasts until you become allies again or after 5 minutes). Traitor displays Yes for 30 seconds when the player betrayed and attacked a player who was in an alliance with them. The icons below represent the following interactions:
help_modal.info_chat: Send a quick chat message to the player. Select a Category, a Phrase, and if the phrase contains [P1] select a Player name to replace it with. Hit Send.
help_modal.info_target: Place a target mark on the player, marking it for all allies, used to coordinate attacks.
help_modal.info_alliance: Send an alliance request to the player. Allies can share resources and troops, but can't attack each other.
help_modal.info_emoji: Send an emoji to the player.
help_modal.info_trade: Use "Stop trading" to stop giving the player gold and receiving their gold via cargo ships. If you both click "Start trading" it will start again.
help_modal.info_ally_desc: When you ally with a player, the following new icons become available:
help_modal.ally_betray: Betray your ally, ending the alliance, halting trade, and weakening your defense. Trading between you is paused for 5 minutes (or until you become allies again) and others may stop trading too. And unless the other player was a traitor themselves, you'll be marked a traitor for 30 seconds. During this time an icon will be above your name and you will have a 50% defense debuff. Bots are less likely to ally with you and players will think twice before doing so.
help_modal.ally_donate: Donate some of your troops to your ally. Used when they're low on troops and are being attacked, or when they need that extra power to crush an enemy.
help_modal.ally_donate_gold: Donate some of your gold to your ally. Used when they're low on gold and need it for buildings, or when your team member is saving for that MIRV.
help_modal.build_menu_desc: Build these or see how many of each you already build:
help_modal.build_city_desc: Increases your max population. Useful when you can't expand your territory or you're about to hit your population limit.
help_modal.build_defense_desc: Increases defenses around nearby borders, which show a checkered pattern. Attacks from enemies are slower and have more casualties.
help_modal.build_port_desc: Can only be built near water. Allows building Cruisers. Automatically sends cargo ships between ports of your country and other countries (except when trade is stopped), giving gold to both sides. Trade stops automatically when you attack or are attacked by a player. It resumes after 5 minutes or if you become allies. You can manually toggle trading with "Stop trading" or "Start trading".
help_modal.build_warship_desc: Patrols in an area, capturing enemy cargo ships and destroying their Boats (transport ships) and Cruisers. Spawns from the nearest Port and patrols the area you first clicked to build it. You can control Cruisers by attack-clicking on them (see action Attack under Hotkeys) and then attack-clicking the new area you want them to move to.
help_modal.build_sam_desc: Can intercept enemy missiles and planes. Intercepts missiles in its 100 pixel range. With a 100% hit chance for Atom Bomb, 80% for Hydrogen Bomb and 50% for individual MIRV Warheads. The SAM has a 7.5 second cooldown for missiles, none for planes.
help_modal.build_atom_desc: Small explosive bomb that destroys territory, buildings, ships and boats. Spawns from the nearest Missile Silo and lands in the area you first clicked to build it.
help_modal.build_hydrogen_desc: Large explosive bomb. Spawns from the nearest Missile Silo and lands in the area you first clicked to build it.
help_modal.build_mirv_desc: The most powerful bomb in the game. Splits up into smaller bombs that will cover a huge range of territory. Only damages the player that you first clicked on to build it. Spawns from the nearest Missile Silo and lands in the area you first clicked to build it.
help_modal.build_airfield_desc: Automatically deploys bombers that fly out to strike enemy structures then return to base.
help_modal.icon_desc: Examples of some of the ingame icons you will encounter and what they mean:
help_modal.icon_crown: Crown - Number 1. This is the top player in the leaderboard.
help_modal.icon_traitor: Broken shield - Traitor. This player attacked an ally.
help_modal.icon_ally: Handshake - Ally. This player is your ally.
help_modal.icon_embargo: Dollar stop sign - Embargo. This player has stopped trading with you automatically or manually.
help_modal.icon_request: Envelope - Alliance request. This player has sent you an alliance request.
help_modal.exit_confirmation: Are you sure you want to exit the game?

getting_started.title: Getting Started
getting_started.objective_description: Win Condition: Be the first player to control 80% of the world map (95% in Team games). Expand your territory, build your economy, develop advanced technology, and dominate your rivals through military conquest or strategic alliances.
getting_started.objective_territory_control: Territory Control: Your map control percentage is shown in the leaderboard (top-left)
getting_started.objective_elimination: Elimination: If you lose all your territory, you're eliminated from the game
getting_started.hotkeys_description: Master these essential controls to play effectively:

hotkeys.space: Toggle alternative view (shows different information overlays)
hotkeys.move_camera: Move camera (pan view in all directions)
hotkeys.attack: Left-click to attack adjacent tiles and expand territory
hotkeys.emote: Send emote to player (quick emote without radial menu)
hotkeys.ratio_scroll: Adjust worker/troop ratio with mouse wheel
hotkeys.ui_scale: Scale UI size up/down (resize interface elements)

getting_started.first_steps_intro: When you start a new game, follow these steps:
getting_started.first_steps_spawn: Select Spawn Point: When the game starts, click on the map to choose your starting location. Pick a strategic position with room to expand.
getting_started.first_steps_ratio: Adjust Worker/Troop Ratio: Press 1 or 2 to balance economy vs military (start with ~50% troops)
getting_started.first_steps_expand: Expand Territory: Left-click on adjacent unconquered tiles to send troops and capture land
getting_started.first_steps_city: Build Your First City: Press Y on the tile you want, or open the Command Center Build menu (bottom left, next to the control panel) and select City, then click on your territory to increase population cap
getting_started.first_steps_economy: Manage Economy: Open the Command Center Economy tab to allocate research funding
getting_started.first_steps_growth: Keep Expanding: Continuously capture neutral territory and bots to grow your empire
getting_started.first_steps_tip: Tip: Focus on expansion and economy in the first 5-10 minutes. Military units come later once you have the infrastructure.
getting_started.territory_neutral: Neutral Territory: Unclaimed tiles can be captured by clicking to send troops
getting_started.territory_enemy: Enemy Territory: Colored tiles belong to other players or bots - you declare war when you attack them
getting_started.territory_capture: Capture Mechanics: Your troops automatically attack adjacent enemy/neutral tiles when you click them
getting_started.territory_loss: Territory Loss: If an enemy captures your tile, you lose that land and any structures on it
getting_started.combat_auto: Automatic Combat: Troops automatically fight when attacking or defending tiles
getting_started.combat_defense: Defensive Advantage: Defending troops have a bonus - attackers need numerical superiority
getting_started.combat_casualties: Casualties: Both sides lose troops in combat. Hospitals can recover some casualties
getting_started.combat_ratio: Attack Ratio: The slider in your control panel determines what % of troops are attacking vs defending
getting_started.population_cap: Population Cap: Determined by the number and level of Cities you build
getting_started.population_growth: Growth Rate: Population grows automatically over time up to your cap
getting_started.population_split: Worker/Troop Split: Use keys 1/2 or Shift + mouse wheel to adjust the ratio
getting_started.population_workers: Workers: Generate gold based on your productivity level
getting_started.population_troops: Troops: Used for attacking, defending, and territorial expansion
getting_started.economy_generation: Gold Generation: Workers x Productivity = Gold per second
getting_started.economy_productivity: Productivity: Increases over time through investment and Factories
getting_started.economy_spending: Spending: Gold is used to build structures, recruit units, and fund research
getting_started.economy_investment: Investment: Allocate income to Research, Roads, and Productivity growth in the Economy tab
getting_started.economy_example: Example: If you have 1,000 workers at 2.0 productivity, you generate 2,000 gold/second.
getting_started.map_colors: Territory Colors: Each player and bot has a unique color - other tiles are neutral
getting_started.map_structures: Structures: Icons on the map show where buildings are located
getting_started.map_roads: Roads: Visible as lines connecting your structures - increase troop movement speed
getting_started.diplomacy_intro: Manage relationships with other players through the Diplomacy tab or radial menu (right-click).
getting_started.diplomacy_neutral: Neutral (Default): You will not attack each other, but you're not allies. You can trade.
getting_started.diplomacy_allied: Allied: You cannot attack each other. Breaking an alliance requires betrayal.
getting_started.diplomacy_war: War: You can attack each other's territory. Declared via "Declare War" or by attacking an ally.
getting_started.diplomacy_peace: Peace Requests: Propose to end a war and return to neutral status. Both players must agree.
getting_started.diplomacy_betrayal: Alliance Breaking: Use "Betray" to break an alliance - this puts you at war with your former ally.
getting_started.diplomacy_warning: Warning: Betraying allies harms your defense. While marked a traitor your defense will be 50% weaker.

ui_guide.title: User Interface
ui_guide.control_panel_intro: The control panel (bottom-left) shows your current resources and population distribution:
ui_guide.control_panel_population: Population: Total population (workers + troops). Example: "15,000 / 30,000" means you have 15k population with a 30k cap
ui_guide.control_panel_gold: Gold: Current gold reserves and income rate. Example: "50,000 (+2,500/s)" means 50k gold, earning 2.5k per second
ui_guide.control_panel_workers: Workers/Troops: Distribution of population between economy and military. Adjust with keys 1/2
ui_guide.control_panel_attack_ratio: Attack Ratio: Percentage of troops currently attacking vs defending. Higher = more aggressive expansion
ui_guide.control_panel_tip: Tip: Don't attack with a large amount of troops. It will leave you vulnerable to counter attacks.
ui_guide.command_center_intro: The Command Center (bottom left, to the right of the control panel) is your main control hub, organized into several tabs for different aspects of your empire management. Open it using the large waffle button next to the control panel.
ui_guide.command_center_build_desc: Construct permanent structures to expand your economy and military capabilities. Buildings include Cities (increase population cap), Defense Posts (fortify territory), Ports (enable naval units), Airfields (enable air units), Hospitals (recover casualties), Research Labs (boost tech speed), Military Academies (increase troop strength), Factories (boost gold income), Missile Silos (enable nuclear weapons), SAM Launchers (air defense), and the Doomsday Device (ultimate deterrent).
ui_guide.command_center_attack_desc: Recruit mobile units for warfare and expansion. Available units include naval forces (Warships, Submarines, Transport Ships, Trade Ships), air units (Bombers, Fighter Jets, Paratroopers), and nuclear weapons (Atom Bombs, Hydrogen Bombs, MIRVs). Each unit type requires specific structures and technologies to unlock. Units can be upgraded to improve their combat effectiveness.
ui_guide.command_center_economy_desc: Manage your financial investments to grow your empire's long-term power. Allocate income between Research (unlock technologies, 0-50% of income), Productivity (increase worker efficiency and gold generation), and Roads (boost troop movement speed and economic output). Balancing these investments is crucial for maintaining both short-term military strength and long-term economic dominance.
ui_guide.command_center_trade_desc: Monitor your international trade network and manage trade ships. Trade ships automatically travel between your ports and other players' ports to generate passive gold income. This tab displays active trade routes, trade ship counts, and allows you to manage your maritime commerce. Trade ships are vulnerable to enemy warships and submarines during wartime.
ui_guide.command_center_diplomacy_desc: Manage diplomatic relations with other players. View all players in the game and their current diplomatic status with you (Neutral, Allied, or War). Propose alliances, declare war, request peace, or betray allies. Diplomatic actions have strategic consequences - betraying allies weakens your defense by 50% while you have the traitor status, and maintaining good relations can provide strategic advantages.
ui_guide.command_center_bombers_desc: Coordinate strategic air strikes from your airfields. Bombers automatically launch from airfields to attack enemy structures and territories, dealing significant damage without risking ground troops. This tab allows you to manage bombing campaigns and target priorities.
ui_guide.radial_intro: Right-click on tiles to access context-sensitive actions:
ui_guide.radial_info: Info: View detailed player information and statistics
ui_guide.radial_transport: Transport Ship: Deploy transport ships to attack across water
ui_guide.radial_peace: Peace: Request peace with neutral players or those you're at war with
ui_guide.radial_war: Declare War: Formally declare war on neutral players
ui_guide.radial_air: Air Attack: Deploy paratroopers from airfields (requires tech)
ui_guide.radial_note: Note: Available options depend on the tile you click and your current capabilities.
ui_guide.events_intro: The events panel displays important notifications:
ui_guide.events_alliance: Alliance Requests: Incoming and outgoing alliance proposals
ui_guide.events_attacks: Attack Warnings: Notifications when you're under attack
ui_guide.events_chat: Quick Chat: Messages and emotes from other players
ui_guide.leaderboard_intro: Located in the top-left corner, the leaderboard shows the current standings of all players in the game.
ui_guide.leaderboard_rankings: Rankings: Players are ranked by territory controlled (percentage of map)
ui_guide.leaderboard_info: Player Info: Shows each player's name, color, and current map control percentage
ui_guide.leaderboard_victory: Victory Condition: Control 80% of the world map (95% in Team games).
ui_guide.leaderboard_updates: Real-time Updates: Rankings update dynamically as territories change hands
ui_guide.research_button_intro: Located on the left side of the screen (center height), this button opens the Technology Research Tree interface.
ui_guide.research_button_view: Tech Tree View: Displays all available technologies organized by category
ui_guide.research_button_progress: Progress Tracking: Shows completion percentage for each technology
ui_guide.research_button_priority: Priority Selection: Click technologies to prioritize them for faster research
ui_guide.research_button_prereq: Prerequisites: Visual connections show which techs must be completed first
ui_guide.research_button_tip: Tip: Regularly check the tech tree to plan your research path and prioritize critical technologies.
ui_guide.options_intro: Located in the top-left corner (near the leaderboard), the options menu provides access to gameplay settings.
ui_guide.options_gameplay: Gameplay Options: Toggle various UI elements and game features to customize your experience
ui_guide.status_intro: Icons appear above player names on the map to show their diplomatic status and relationship with you:
ui_guide.status_peace: Peace Symbol: Indicates you have an active peace agreement with this player. Neither can attack the other until the peace is broken.
ui_guide.status_alliance_request: Alliance Request: Shows when a player has sent you an alliance proposal that you haven't responded to yet.
ui_guide.status_traitor: Traitor Symbol: Appears when a player has betrayed an alliance. Traitors suffer a 50% defense penalty until the status expires.
ui_guide.status_embargo: Embargo Symbol: Indicates you have placed a trade embargo on this player, preventing trade ships from traveling to their ports.
ui_guide.status_tip: Tip: These icons help you quickly identify the diplomatic status of players without opening menus.

structures.title: Structures
structures.intro: Structures are essential for your economy and military. Build them using Hotkeys or by selecting them from the Command Center Build Menu.

city.name: City
city.desc: Urban centers for population mobilization. Increases manpower cap by 30,000 per level. Tip: Establish early to secure long-term growth.

defense_post.name: Defense Post
defense_post.desc: Fortified strongpoints to stall enemy advances. Provides defensive bonuses to stationed troops. Range: 40 tiles. Tip: Deploy at chokepoints to create kill zones.

port.name: Port
port.desc: Naval logistics hubs. Enables construction of Warships and Submarines for maritime dominance. Automatically deploys Trade Ships. Tip: Vital for projecting power across oceans.

airfield.name: Airfield
airfield.desc: Strategic air command bases. Essential for projecting air power. Bomber Range: 250 / 350 / 450 tiles (by level). Tip: Strike deep behind enemy lines.

hospital.name: Hospital
hospital.desc: Field medical centers. Critical for sustaining combat operations. First facility recovers ~10% of casualties; max ~40%. Tip: Secure one early to conserve manpower.

research_lab.name: Research Lab
research_lab.desc: Advanced weapons development facilities. Accelerates technological breakthroughs. First lab provides ~40% boost, second ~20%, halving thereafter. Tip: Maintain technological superiority.

military_academy.name: Military Academy
military_academy.desc: Officer training grounds. Enhances troop combat effectiveness by up to 20%. First academy yields ~10% boost. Tip: Train elite forces before major offensives.

factory.name: Factory
factory.desc: Industrial production complexes. Boosts gold generation efficiency. First complex increases output by ~27%. Tip: Fuel the war machine with robust industry.

missile_silo.name: Missile Silo
missile_silo.desc: Strategic launch sites. The cornerstone of nuclear deterrence. Enables Atom Bombs, Hydrogen Bombs, and MIRVs. Tip: Mutually Assured Destruction is a valid strategy.

sam_launcher.name: SAM Launcher
sam_launcher.desc: Air defense batteries. Intercepts incoming aircraft and missiles. Range: 70 / 95 / 128 tiles (by level). Tip: Create an iron dome over key assets.

doomsday.name: Doomsday Device
doomsday.desc: The ultimate deterrent. Activation triggers a catastrophic radioactive event, neutralizing territory and crippling global infrastructure. Warning: Use only as a last resort.

structures.hotkeys_intro: Configurable Hotkeys: You can customize hotkeys for building structures.
structures.hotkeys_view: View Hotkeys: Check the Settings menu to see and customize your hotkeys
structures.hotkeys_reference: Quick Reference: Look in the bottom right corner of the build items in the Command Center Build Menu (bottom left, next to the control panel) to see their assigned hotkeys

units.title: Units
units.intro: Mobile units are recruited from the Attack tab in the Command Center. They require specific structures and technologies to unlock.
units.deployment_recruitment: Recruitment: Units are built from the Attack tab (Command Center, bottom left, next to the control panel)
units.deployment_ai: Automatic AI: Most units operate autonomously - they patrol, defend, and engage enemies automatically
units.deployment_manual: Manual Control: Some units (Transport Ships, Nukes) require manual targeting via right-click menu
units.deployment_prereq: Prerequisites: Units require specific structures (e.g., Port for ships, Airfield for aircraft)
units.deployment_upgrades: Upgrades: Click the upgrade arrow on unit cards to improve their stats (requires tech research)

transport.name: Transport Ship
transport.desc:
Requirement: Port
Carries troops across water to expand your territory overseas. Essential for island hopping. Capacity: Can carry large numbers of troops.

warship.name: Warship
warship.desc:
Requirement: Port
Powerful naval combat vessel. Patrols and engages enemy naval units (and trade ships during war). Upgrades: Levels 2/3 boost hull and damage (HP 1250/1500; +70 dmg per level).

submarine.name: Submarine
submarine.desc:
Requirement: Port
Stealth naval unit used to ambush trade ships and warships. Tip: Great for surprise attacks and map control on water maps.

trade_ship.name: Trade Ship
trade_ship.desc:
Requirement: Port
Generates gold by trading between your ports and other players' ports (not between your own ports). Passive income source. Tip: Protect trade routes from pirates and enemy submarines.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.desc:
Requirement: Airfield
Aircraft that bombs enemy structures and territories. Launches from airfields and must return. Vulnerable to: Fighter jets and SAM launchers. Upgrades: Longer range (250/350/450), faster (speed 2/3/4), tougher (500/600/700 HP), more damage (250/300/350).

fighter.name: Fighter Jet
fighter.desc:
Requirement: Airfield
Fast aircraft that intercepts bombers and missiles. Can patrol areas for air defense. Upgrades: Levels 2-4 increase damage and HP (dmg +100 per level; HP 1000/1250/1500). Naval targeting comes from tech, not levels.

paratrooper.name: Paratrooper
paratrooper.desc:
Requirement: Airfield
Airborne troops that can be dropped behind enemy lines for surprise attacks. Tip: Excellent for capturing isolated enemy territories.

atom.name: Atom Bomb
atom.desc:
Requirement: Missile Silo
First-generation nuclear weapon. Destroys structures and kills troops in blast radius. Range: Limited by trajectory calculation.

hydrogen.name: Hydrogen Bomb
hydrogen.desc:
Requirement: Missile Silo
More powerful than Atom Bomb. Larger blast radius and more damage. Tip: Can devastate entire regions in one strike.

mirv.name: MIRV
mirv.desc:
Requirement: Missile Silo
Multiple Independently targetable Reentry Vehicles. Splits into multiple warheads. Special: Each warhead can target different locations.

investment.title: Investment & Research
investment.overview_desc: You can allocate a portion of your income to various investments that provide long-term strategic benefits. Investment reduces your immediate gold income but provides advantages that compound over time.
investment.research_intro: Research unlocks new technologies in the tech tree. You can allocate up to 50% of your income to research.
investment.research_rate: Investment Rate: Adjustable from 0-50% of your income
investment.research_speed: Research Speed: Higher investment = faster technology unlocks
investment.research_labs: Research Labs: Each lab increases research speed with diminishing returns (first +40%, second +20%, halving thereafter)
investment.research_tip: Strategy Tip: Keep research funded to avoid falling behind in tech.
investment.productivity_intro: Productivity represents your industrial capacity and worker efficiency. It determines how much gold each worker generates.
investment.productivity_growth: Growth Rate: Determined by your investment rate (portion of income not spent)
investment.productivity_compound: Compound Effect: Higher productivity = more gold = faster productivity growth
investment.productivity_loss: Loss Conditions: Can be reduced through warfare, nukes, and scorched earth
investment.productivity_importance: Long-term Impact: Most important economic stat for late-game dominance
investment.productivity_tip: Strategy Tip: Balance short-term spending with long-term productivity growth.
investment.roads_intro: Roads increase troop movement speed across your territory and provide economic bonuses through improved trade and logistics.
investment.roads_rate: Investment Rate: Adjustable from 0-100% of your income
investment.roads_effects: Effects: Faster movement for troops and improved connectivity for trade
investment.roads_maintenance: Maintenance Cost: Roads require ongoing maintenance based on network length
investment.roads_break_even: Break-Even Point: Shown on slider - where construction cost equals maintenance
investment.roads_quality: Quality: Currently constant at 100%, may vary in future updates
investment.roads_completion: Completion: Percentage of planned roads that are finished
investment.roads_tip: Strategy Tip: Invest heavily early to build network quickly, then reduce to maintenance level.
investment.strategy_intro: Effective investment requires balancing multiple competing priorities:
investment.strategy_early: Early Game: Focus on productivity growth and essential techs
investment.strategy_mid: Mid Game: Balance roads, research, and military spending
investment.strategy_late: Late Game: Maximize productivity while maintaining military superiority
investment.strategy_under_attack: Under Attack: Reduce investments to fund immediate defense
investment.research_strategy_early: Early Game: Rush economy techs (Roads, Hospitals, Research Labs)
investment.research_strategy_mid: Mid Game: Balance military and economic techs based on threats
investment.research_strategy_late: Late Game: Focus on advanced weapons and unit upgrades
investment.research_strategy_defensive: Defensive: Prioritize SAM launchers and fighter jets if facing air attacks
investment.research_strategy_offensive: Offensive: Rush nuclear weapons for devastating strikes
investment.research_strategy_naval: Naval Maps: Prioritize submarine and warship upgrades early

tech_tree.title: Technology Tree
tech_tree.overview_desc: The tech tree contains technologies organized into five categories: Land, Sea, Air, Nuclear, and Economy. Each technology provides unique bonuses, unlocks new units, or enables new capabilities.
tech_tree.research_prereq: Prerequisites: Technologies have requirements that must be researched first
tech_tree.research_all_of: "All Of" Requirements: Red connections - all prerequisites must be completed
tech_tree.research_one_of: "One Of" Requirements: Yellow connections - only one prerequisite needed
tech_tree.research_priority: Priority Selection: Click on a tech to prioritize it (receives 50% of research)
tech_tree.research_progress: Progress Display: Each tech shows completion percentage
tech_tree.research_completion: Completion Indicator: Completed techs are marked with a checkmark
tech_tree.research_beakers: Research Beakers: Progress is measured in "beakers" (research points)

categories.land_desc: Technologies that improve ground warfare, troop strength, and territorial control.
categories.sea_desc: Naval technologies including submarines, warship upgrades, and maritime capabilities.
categories.air_desc: Aviation technologies including jet engines, bombers, fighters, and air defense.
categories.nuclear_desc: Nuclear weapons progression from atomic bombs to MIRVs and the Doomsday Device.
categories.economy_desc: Economic technologies including roads, trade, hospitals, research labs, and structure insurance.

strategy.title: Strategy & Tips
strategy.early_intro: The first 10 minutes set the foundation for your entire game. Focus on expansion and economy.
strategy.early_starting_position: Pick a Starting Position: Choose a position that allows you to expand in multiple directions. Avoid being surrounded by enemies.
strategy.early_expand: Start Expanding Immediately: Click adjacent neutral tiles to capture territory. Don't wait - every second counts!
strategy.early_balance: Balance Workers/Troops: Start with ~60% troops (press 1 or 2 to adjust). Too many workers = weak expansion. Too many troops = low income.
strategy.early_city: Build Your First City: Once you have enough gold, build a City to increase your population cap.
strategy.early_research: Allocate Research Funding: Open Economy tab and set research to 10-20%. Early tech advantage is crucial.
strategy.early_keep_expanding: Keep Expanding: Continuously capture neutral territory. More land = more resources = faster growth.
strategy.early_watch_borders: Watch Your Borders: Pay attention to nearby players. If someone is expanding aggressively toward you, prepare for conflict.
strategy.mid_intro: Shift from pure expansion to strategic development and military buildup.
strategy.mid_diversify: Diversify Structures: Build Ports (trade), Hospitals (troop recovery), Research Labs (faster tech), and Factories (more gold).
strategy.mid_research_priority: Research Priority: Focus on economy techs first (Roads, Hospitals, Research Labs), then military techs based on threats.
strategy.mid_alliances: Form Alliances: Ally with neighbors to secure borders and focus expansion in other directions.
strategy.mid_naval_air: Build Naval/Air Power: If you have coastline, build Ports. Research Jet Engines for air superiority.
strategy.mid_productivity: Productivity Investment: Keep some gold uninvested to grow productivity - this compounds over time.
strategy.mid_roads: Road Network: Invest in roads to speed up troop movement across your empire.
strategy.late_intro: Push for victory through overwhelming force or strategic strikes.
strategy.late_weapons: Advanced Weapons: Research and build nuclear weapons if you have the infrastructure.
strategy.late_air: Air Superiority: Bombers can cripple enemy infrastructure. Fighter jets protect against enemy air attacks.
strategy.late_defense: Defensive Depth: Build SAM Launchers and Defense Posts to protect key territories.
strategy.late_economy: Economic Snowball: High productivity + multiple Factories = massive gold income for military spam.
strategy.late_coordination: Coordinate Attacks: Use multiple attack vectors (ground, naval, air) simultaneously to overwhelm defenses.
strategy.late_doomsday: Watch for Doomsday: If an enemy is losing badly, they might activate a Doomsday Device. Be prepared.
strategy.mistake_research: Ignoring Research: Players who don't invest in research fall behind in tech and lose to advanced units.
strategy.mistake_balance: All Workers or All Troops: You need balance. 100% workers = no expansion and vulnerable to attacks. 100% troops = no income.
strategy.mistake_overextend: Overextending Territory: Expanding too thin makes you vulnerable. Consolidate before pushing further.
strategy.mistake_defense: Neglecting Defense: Build Defense Posts and keep troops defending your borders, not just attacking.
strategy.mistake_diplomacy: Ignoring Diplomacy: Making enemies on all sides is a recipe for defeat. Ally strategically.
strategy.mistake_trade: Forgetting About Trade Ships: Ports automatically deploy trade ships - protect them for passive income.
strategy.advanced_productivity_intro: The most powerful long-term strategy. Productivity compounds massively over time.
strategy.advanced_productivity_step1: Keep 20-30% of your income uninvested (not spent on research, roads, or buildings)
strategy.advanced_productivity_step2: This saved income automatically increases your productivity
strategy.advanced_productivity_step3: Higher productivity = more gold = faster productivity growth = economic dominance
strategy.advanced_productivity_step4: Build Factories to accelerate this process
strategy.advanced_bombers_intro: Use bombers to destroy enemy infrastructure without ground combat.
strategy.advanced_bombers_step1: Build multiple Airfields to increase bomber range and production
strategy.advanced_bombers_step2: Target enemy Factories, Research Labs, and Missile Silos to cripple their economy and military
strategy.advanced_bombers_step3: Upgrade bombers for longer range, higher speed, and more damage
strategy.advanced_bombers_step4: Watch for enemy SAM Launchers and Fighter Jets - they counter bombers
strategy.advanced_naval_intro: Control the seas to dominate island maps and coastal regions.
strategy.advanced_naval_step1: Build multiple Ports for more Warships, Submarines, and Trade Ships
strategy.advanced_naval_step2: Submarines are stealthy - use them to hunt enemy trade ships and naval units
strategy.advanced_naval_step3: Warships can be upgraded to shoot down aircraft (requires tech)
strategy.advanced_naval_step4: Protect your trade ships - they generate significant passive income
strategy.advanced_nuclear_intro: Nuclear weapons can turn the tide of war but require careful use.
strategy.advanced_nuclear_step1: Build Missile Silos in secure, inland locations (hard to bomb)
strategy.advanced_nuclear_step2: Atom Bombs are good for tactical strikes on enemy structures
strategy.advanced_nuclear_step3: Hydrogen Bombs have larger blast radius - use for devastating area denial
strategy.advanced_nuclear_step4: MIRVs split into multiple warheads - can target multiple locations simultaneously
strategy.advanced_nuclear_step5: Warning: Nuking allies will break your alliance and put you at war
strategy.advanced_alliance_intro: Use diplomacy as a weapon to control the game's political landscape.
strategy.advanced_alliance_step1: Ally with strong players to avoid conflict while you build up
strategy.advanced_alliance_step2: Betray allies when they're weak or distracted by other wars
strategy.advanced_alliance_step3: Propose alliances to players who are fighting each other to weaken both
strategy.advanced_alliance_step4: Use the Info panel (right-click > Info) to assess player strength before engaging
strategy.map_island: Island Maps: Prioritize Ports and naval tech. Control the seas to control the map.
strategy.map_continental: Continental Maps: Focus on ground expansion and road networks for fast troop movement.
strategy.map_large: Large Maps: Airfields become crucial for projecting power across vast distances.
strategy.map_small: Small Maps: Expect early conflict. Build Defense Posts and Military Academies quickly.
